start.dialog: My brother fell through a time portal! He's lost somewhere in history—could be yesterday, could be a thousand years ago! The portal signature is faint, but traceable. Follow it, find him, bring him home! Please!
start.objective: Trace the portal signature to find the lost time traveler

progress.dialog: He's in the Age of Giants, three centuries ago! But he's been there for weeks—he's started a life, made friends, maybe even changed history slightly! Convince him to return without causing temporal damage!
progress.objective: Convince the lost traveler to return without disrupting the timeline

complete.dialog: He's home! The timeline is stable—minimal contamination! The brothers are reunited! As thanks, they give you this Chrono-Compass! It always points to your proper time and place!

party_comments.kade: He didn't want to leave his giant friends. I get it. Giants are cool.
party_comments.twist: We had to memory-wipe some giants. Unfortunate, but necessary.
party_comments.nix7: Temporal rescue: successful. Timeline contamination: acceptable levels.
